name: Tate vs Hoko! ~Saikyou no Imouto to Muteki no Osananajimi, Koi no Yuuwaku Daigassen~
original_name: たて vs ほこ! ～最強の妹と無敵の幼馴染、恋の誘惑大合戦～
source:
"Who the hell are you?! Don't lay a hand on my Minoru!!"

"Huh... M-mine... You mean my brother?! Th-that's... impossible...!!"

A chaotic scene unfolds before my eyes.
The two girls fighting are the complete opposites.

One is my frail, helpless little sister, Mamori.
The other is my glamorous, assertive, caring childhood friend, Saki.

For some reason, both of them seem to be in love with me.

Being pursued by both my little sister and childhood friend at the same time, what kind of romantic comedy manga is this?!
...Anyway, I can't leave things as they are. 
I have to skillfully fend off their advances... 
No, that's impossible!

What kind of ending awaits my love for them...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/appx-touch/work/=/product_id/VJ01005775.html/]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
“你到底是谁？！别对我稔下手！！”

“呃……我、我的……你是说我哥哥吗？！这、那……不可能……！！”

一片混乱的景象展现在我的眼前。
打架的两个女孩性格完全相反。

其中之一是我脆弱无助的妹妹护。
另一个是我迷人、自信、体贴的儿时朋友萨基。

出于某种原因，他们俩似乎都爱着我。

被妹妹和​​青梅竹马同时追求，这是什么爱情喜剧漫画？！
……总之，我不能就这样放任不管。
我必须巧妙地抵挡他们的进攻…… 
不，那不可能！

我对他们的爱将会有怎样的结局等待着……？

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/appx-touch/work/=/product_id/VJ01005775.html/]DLsite[/url]]
